stories.title: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
stories.body: Some Republicans tell the BBC the president's focus on his legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost them.

stories.title: US midterm results a 'victory' for Canadians hopeful of tariff relief
stories.body: With Canada-US trade talks back on, Tuesday’s midterm Democratic wave puts pressure on the White House to come to a deal.

stories.title: Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing
stories.body: At least 40 people were killed and another 30 may still be under the rubble after Monday's attack on a Ukrainian village, Kyiv says.

stories.title: French blood storage impacted by freezer hacks as theories swirl about culprits
stories.body: The French Blood Establishment (EFS) said cold rooms storing blood were impacted by hackers.

stories.title: 'Most difficult days of my life' for keeper Owono
stories.body: FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono puts out a statement through his club, expressing his sorrow and pain after Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel's death.

stories.title: Israel's president begins consultations with parties after election deadlock
stories.body: Herzog warns politicians that "not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled" if they want to avoid another election.

stories.title: Delhi air quality worsens ahead of Diwali as firework restrictions enter force
stories.body: On Wednesday morning, Delhi's air quality index reading stood at 377, in the "very poor" category.

stories.title: Secret police files released in Hungary, 37 years after fall of communism
stories.body: Critics say the move comes too late, that the files themselves are incomplete, and the move risks sowing division and causing unnecessary anguish.

stories.title: Iran's chief negotiator says Americans voted 'no to war'
stories.body: "We endorse this message," Mohammed Bagher Ghalibaf says, as Donald Trump acknowledges the conflict's role in the Republican Party's defeat.

stories.title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline
stories.body: As South Africans vote in local elections, residents tell the BBC they are tired of the poor quality of services they get.

stories.title: Nadal set to join Real Madrid board of directors
stories.body: Tennis great Rafael Nadal is set to join the board of Spanish football giants Real Madrid.

stories.title: Sharp objects found in Halloween sweets in three European nations
stories.body: Dozens of cases are reported in Austria, Germany and Hungary, including a nine-year-old girl hurting her tongue while eating chocolate containing a pin.

stories.title: Rwanda's army team removed from Africa league after US sanctions, NBA says
stories.body: The US imposed sanctions on Rwanda's army over its role in the conflict in DR Congo.

stories.title: 'I'm not a quitter': Kim Kardashian on retaking the bar exam
stories.body: The All's Fair star tells the BBC she has not given up, but will be "more quiet" about her journey to become a lawyer.

stories.title: Film star Ranbir Kapoor on AI, movies and fatherhood
stories.body: The film star plays the leading role in a major new adaptation of the Indian epic Ramayana.

stories.title: What Florida jet audio and flight data tells us about its final moments
stories.body: A private jet crashed in Florida on Sunday, killing all nine people on board, according to US authorities.

stories.title: 'All this food is now useless': Piles of rubbish after shop freezers hit by cyber-attack
stories.body: Dozens of supermarkets in seven European countries dumped huge quantities of food after refrigerators and freezers were targeted in a cyber-attack.

stories.body: Both Ukraine and Russia say their air raid alert apps were cyber-attacked - Joe Tidy explains what we know so far.

The cautious mood reflects the need for more clarity on how these developments will translate into actionable outcomes.

Additionally, the broader implications of governance challenges in Hungary and other regions warrant close monitoring for potential ripple effects.
